section.title: Old tool results
section.subtitle: Swap older tool results for a placeholder: only the request body changes and the session log stays intact; by default the clearing point advances only once enough has accumulated
field.enabled.label: Trim old tool results
field.enabled.help: When on, the body of older tool results is replaced with a one-line placeholder (the original text in the session log is untouched). When off, everything is sent as is.
field.refresh.label: When to trim
field.refresh.option.budget: Once enough has accumulated (default, best cache hits)
field.refresh.option.round: Once at the start of each round (saves context, fewer cache hits)
field.refresh.option.request: On every request (most context saved, the prefix often goes cold)
field.refresh.help: One round = the dozens of steps the model takes after you send a message. The clearing point advances only once enough has accumulated (8192 characters of new savings): between advances the prefix the model sees stays unchanged, so the server-side prefix cache keeps hitting. Trimming every round moves the clearing point each round, and everything after it is re-read at full price.
field.keepRecent.label: Tool results kept as they are
field.keepRecent.help: These stay untouched and only older ones are trimmed. Larger values keep more original text for the model to look back at and save less context.
field.minSaveTokens.label: Minimum saving per result (tokens)
field.minSaveTokens.help: Trimming a short result saves little and loses evidence, so anything under this threshold stays. 0 means trim whenever it saves anything.
field.minFreePercent.label: Minimum total saving (%)
field.minFreePercent.help: How much of the whole prompt has to be trimmed this time; below that nothing is trimmed. Cached tokens cost roughly a tenth and everything after a miss is re-read at full price, so trimming too little costs more than it saves. Default 25; 0 means trim whenever it saves anything.
save.badRefresh: When to trim must be budget (once enough has accumulated), round (once per round) or request (on every request).
